en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with an oval photograph showing a town square bordered by historic multi‑story buildings with arcades, a tall clock tower, a large fountain with statues, and people walking in the open plaza. Mountains rise in the background. The upper left corner of the card bears the caption "TRENTO" and the lower right reads "Piazza del Duomo e Torre Grande."
